title: Frappe ERPNext 15.10.4 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.10.4 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users to create Serial No and Batch master records without proper create permission checks, potentially compromising inventory data integrity.
